demonstrates: Field process output is untrusted input. One durable record and its committed checkpoint precede a sequence of hostile output shapes: a non-JSON line, an unknown event type, a sequence regression, invalid UTF-8, and an oversized frame. Each is a failed run, and none of them undoes the committed checkpoint.
notes: Each hostile shape is shown once for review. In the conformance kit each is its own case with its own fixture Field, because a real run stops at the first violation.

body.text:
# Rollout reference

Local reference material describing the rollout checklist.

detail: Committed and durable. Everything that follows must not be able to unmake this.

note: Not JSON. Rejected as 'protocol.not_json'; the run fails.
bytes_utf8: Traceback (most recent call last): NullPointerException in mail mapper

note: An unknown event type. v1 has no permissive branch, so this is 'protocol.unknown_event' and the run fails. A Field cannot introduce an event by emitting one.

Schema-valid in isolation, but its sequence number regresses from 2 to 1. Ordering is a protocol rule a single-frame schema cannot express, so core enforces it: 'protocol.seq_regression', and the run fails.
A frame whose bytes are not valid UTF-8: the two-byte sequence C3 28, which cannot be embedded in this JSON transcript. Rejected as 'protocol.invalid_utf8'.
bytes_description: the ASCII text '{"v":1,"type":"record","body":"' followed by the raw bytes C3 28 and then '"}' and one LF

note: A frame larger than the negotiated frame limit. Core stops reading the line at the limit, rejects it as 'protocol.oversized_frame', and never buffers the remainder.
bytes_description: a single line of 4 MiB against a 1 MiB max_frame_bytes: a record frame whose body text is padded with repeated 'A'

note: Standard output closed in the middle of a line, so the final frame never terminated. Rejected as 'protocol.truncated_frame' rather than parsed as far as it got.
bytes_description: the ASCII text '{"v":1,"type":"checkpoint","run_id":"1a4c9f2e-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b","seq":9,"cur' with no closing brace and no LF, then end of file

detail: Any one of the shapes above fails the run at the first occurrence.
Core stops consuming output, terminates the child after the cancellation grace period, and removes the run's staging directory.

Field outcome is failed. The Note and cursor committed at the start of this run remain durable and correct; no checkpoint after the violation is committed; the next run resumes from the committed cursor and replays safely.
